endpoint: explicit Selectel regional S3 URL; default path-style, immutable WithVirtualHosted selects bucket-host derivation; both saved as exact refs with no redirect/fallback/AWS defaults

request.native_model: AWS service/s3 v1.114.3 presign_post.go + Selectel published generate_presigned_post example
request.mapping: SDK-owned typed PostOptions mapped into base64 JSON policy and protected form values; source PresignPostOptions.Conditions is deliberately restricted, never raw caller policy
excluded_variants: POST form only: exact key and content type/metadata equality conditions; no key templates/prefix conditions, ACL, redirects or arbitrary policy JSON; caller submits file last, no SDK HTTP upload
policy_fields: required exact SigV4 algorithm/date/credential and optional session token

response.mapping: native URL -> protected URL; Values -> protected Fields; Policy is protected Fields[policy]; ExpiresAt is exact generated policy expiration
response.limitation: Local form generation only; no SDK HTTP POST/file transfer or remote acknowledgement

errors.local: invalid_argument, scope_mismatch, endpoint_unavailable, credentials_unavailable, unauthenticated, canceled/deadline_exceeded; common validation/auth/budget rules
errors.remote: caller submits form independently; no remote response/error mapping claimed

retry: No HTTP, retry or mutation receipt during signing
recovery: unavailable: no mutation executed by presign; caller owns remote submission outcome
wait: unavailable for local presign; exact object HEAD is separate observation only
shared_provenance: reviewed Swift DoResponse 8a07c83 plus reviewed receipt support379458e
local_presign: PresignPost only: no HTTP/Receipt; explicit 1..900 second expiry and nonnegative size range with positive max, exact bucket/key; generated equality conditions; all URL/form/policy protected
